item.title: Citations
item.description:
Parent: [[guides/index|Guides]]. Policy: [[notice|Notice]] · [[guides/sources]].

A Graphene-Info URL here is radar unless a filing is next to it.

Standards and regulators

  • ISO/TS 80004-13:2017 and :2024 — iso.org catalogue (vocabulary; 2017 withdrawn).
  • ISO/TS 21356-1:2021 — structural characterization of graphene from powders and dispersions.
  • NIOSH graphene-family field sampling / banding notes cited on the NIOSH topic pages.
  • Health Canada MDEL 18823; PRD classification 6 May 2026 (ZenGUARD filters) — Zentek 6 May 2026 release / SEC exhibit.
  • Companies House filing history, Versarien Graphene Ltd 07475659.
  • USAspending award W911QX22C0019 (Vorbeck).

Papers (named on timeline / science pages)

  • Wallace, Phys. Rev. 1947.
  • Novoselov et al. 2004 isolation / field effect.
  • Dean 2010 hBN encapsulation.
  • Britnell 2012; Levendorf 2012; Nair Science 2012; Koenig/Bunch 2012; Furchi 2012.
  • 2013 Nat. Photonics waveguide PD cluster.
  • Liu Nat. Nanotechnol. 2014; Koppens review 2014; Cai THz 2014.
  • Kim Nat. Nanotechnol. 2015; Thomas ACS Nano 2015 holey stencil.
  • Ruffieux/Cai Nature 2016 ZGNRs.
  • Abraham Nat. Nanotechnol. 2017 confined GO sieve.
  • Cao et al. Nature 556 (2018) magic-angle insulator and SC.
  • Yoo Nat. Mater. 2019; Chen Nature 2019 ABC trilayer.
  • Stepanov Nat. Phys. 2020; Cao 2020 Nature.
  • Cao/Park Nature 595 (2021) MATTG Pauli limit.
  • Kim Nature 606 (2022); Park/Cao Nat. Mater. 2022.
  • Zhou Nature 613 (2023); Su Nat. Mater. 22 (2023).
  • Andrews et al. 2024 GO inhalation (NCT03659864).
  • ISO 80004-13:2024.
  • Nature 637 (2025) moiré Hall crystal; 2025 superfluid-stiffness note.

Company and exchange primaries

  • First Graphene — 9 Sep 2026 Pacific Urethanes production-order release.
  • Haydale — JustHeat install guide V25; JustHeat white paper Mar 2025; SETTF partner notes.
  • GMG — 9 Jul 2026 THERMAL-XR 30,000 h ASTM B117-19 release.
  • Directa Plus — company technology / membrane / GRAFYSORBER pages.
  • Zentek — 6 May 2026 filter classification release; coatings pages.
  • Universal Matter — AGM acquisition and Genable lay notices.
  • Sparc / HydroGraph — company case study (ISO 9227 / 12944), Preliminary.
  • Black Swan, HydroGraph, Talga, CVD Equipment, COnovate, Charmgraphene, Graphene Square, Sixth Element, 2D Carbon, Knano, XFNANO, Pacific Urethanes — company contact and site pages named on the plant notes.
  • Raises on [[topics/finance/raises-2015-2025]] cite the dated ASX/AIM/TSX notices on that page.

Radar

  • Graphene-Info — names and dates only.
  • PitchBook / Nanowerk / Kompass — address rows when the company page was thin.
  • Business Live / Construction Index — Versarien administration.

This site

  • graphenefacts.org
  • github.com/GrapheneFacts/quartz (v5)
  • github.com/GrapheneFacts/graphene-archive

item.title: Notice
item.description:
This is the only official disclaimer and transparency page for graphenefacts.org. Other pages should not repeat it. Sources used to build pages: [[citations|Citations]].

What this site is

A public, labeled archive of graphene-family materials: forms, history, papers, plants, money notices, occupational and biomedical records, and (separately) circulating rumors. Short notes may still appear on @GrapheneFacts. The durable copy is here.

Files: graphene-archive. Engine: quartz (content/ on v5). Private compile work is not published.
